name: Momentum + crash brake
tagline: A loose 20/60-session momentum gate with an explicit fast-drawdown crash brake and a 5-day-high re-entry.
summary: Holds TQQQ while either momentum horizon is positive, overrides to cash on a fast 20-day drawdown plus a vol-spike or 3-day-loss confirmation, and re-enters on a 5-day high with positive 20-day momentum. It wins 2020 and 2022 and loses every other year; the full 35.61% misses the bar.
caveat: The edge is crash avoidance (wins 2020 and 2022, loses every other year); the 2024-26 holdout earns 20.10% and the full 35.61% misses the 37.54% bar.
